Combine text and supported media inputs with Gemini model capabilities for focused analysis and generation. MoreSpace can build document-intake assistants, visual-content review queues, and structured information workflows around your approved material. Function calling connects models with application logic; the application still validates results and decides what operations the user is allowed to perform.

Useful outputs

  • Validated field-level results
  • Review findings with source context
  • Structured summaries ready for approval

Where we can apply it

  • Document upload → field extraction → reviewer correction → database record.
  • Creative asset → brand checklist review → designer decision → approved version.
  • Research notes → structured summary → analyst validation → decision brief.

Inputs we need

  • Permissioned documents or media
  • An explicit output schema
  • A defined brand or task checklist

Delivery sequence

  • Select a model that supports the required input and output types.
  • Apply the schema and connect only approved application functions.
  • Test against a labeled sample and queue uncertain outputs for review.

Expert review points

  • Check interpretation of visuals and documents against the originals.
  • Verify external actions and factual claims before release.
